classification.difficultyReason: Divide a mass among three ratio parts and express the resulting quantities in appropriate units.

content.prompt: Fertiliser is made up of three nutrients nitrogen, potassium and phosphorus in the ratio $4:5:3$. How much of each nutrient is present in a $1.5$ kg bag?

answer.short: Nitrogen: $500$ g; potassium: $625$ g; phosphorus: $375$ g.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}1.5\text{ kg}&=1500\text{ g}\\(4+5+3)\text{ parts}&=12\text{ parts}\\12\text{ parts}&=1500\text{ g}\\1\text{ part}&=1500\div12=125\text{ g}\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times125=500\text{ g}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times125=625\text{ g}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times125=375\text{ g}\end{align*}$$
Nitrogen: $500$ g; potassium: $625$ g; phosphorus: $375$ g.
